data.summary:
Experienced Product Management professional with 14+ yrs dedicated to building scalable payments, reconciliation, Reporting and fintech platforms across B2B2C and SaaS ecosystems and Digital transformations. and 7 yrs in Back Office Ops was part of Capital Markets, Account maintenance and Investment banking. Passionate about understanding customer pain points and identifying business opportunities to meet their needs, for digital transformation, and business innovation.
Expertise in Payments (Card, ACH, billing, autopay), B2B SAAS solutions for Fintech Reconciliation & Confirmations and Settlement systems Custody FX & Program trading and capital markets platforms, Regulatory, Governance, compliance, and reporting solutions Strong track record of driving end-to-end product delivery, improving transaction success rates, reducing processing costs, and enabling scalable financial systems.
